translated_text: One Creator, Truth is His Name, Creative Being, Without Fear, Without Hate, Timeless Form, Unborn, Self-Existent, Known by the Guru's Grace.
original_text: Ik Onkar, Satnam, Karta Purakh, Nirbhau, Nirvair, Akal Murat, Ajuni, Saibhang, Gurprasad.
title: Mool Mantar (Root Prayer)
transliteration: Ik Onkar, Satnam, Karta Purakh, Nirbhau, Nirvair, Akal Murat, Ajuni, Saibhang, Gurprasad.

translated_text: The True Name, the Creative Being, Without Fear, Without Hate, Timeless Form, Unborn, Self-Existent, Known by the Guru's Grace.
original_text: Sat Naam Karta Purakh Nirbhau Nirvair Akal Murat Ajuni Saibhang Gurprasad.
title: Japji Sahib - Pauri 1
transliteration: Sat Naam Karta Purakh Nirbhau Nirvair Akal Murat Ajuni Saibhang Gurprasad.

translated_text: God is wonderful, wonderful, wonderful, wonderful. Chanting the Name brings peace.
title: Waheguru Simran

translated_text: The Destroyer of sorrow, the Giver of peace, the Sanctuary.
title: Rehras Sahib (Evening Prayer)

translated_text: With friends, the Sohila is sung on the easy path.
original_text: Sathī nāl sohilā sahaj pathāṇīkai sāṅg.
title: Kirtan Sohila (Night Prayer)
transliteration: Sathi nal sohila sahaj pathanikai sang.

translated_text: The Khalsa belongs to God, Victory belongs to God.
original_text: Waheguru Ji Ka Khalsa, Waheguru Ji Ki Fateh.
title: Ardas (Sikh Prayer)
transliteration: Waheguru Ji Ka Khalsa, Waheguru Ji Ki Fateh.

translated_text: Uncut hair, wooden comb, steel bracelet, cotton undergarment, ceremonial sword — symbols of spiritual and temporal identity.
original_text: Kesh, Kangha, Kara, Kachera, Kirpan — the five articles of faith worn by baptized Sikhs.
title: The Five Ks (Panj Kakaar)

translated_text: Holy Guru Granth Sahib, the Father is Guru Nanak, followed by Guru Angad, Guru Amar Das, Guru Ram Das.
original_text: Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji, Devan Pita Guru Nanak, Devan Pitri Guru Angad, Guru Amar Das Guru Ram Das.
title: Guru Granth Sahib Invocation
transliteration: Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji, Devan Pita Guru Nanak, Devan Pitri Guru Angad, Guru Amar Das Guru Ram Das.

translated_text: Chant the Name, share with others, earn an honest living.
original_text: Nām jāpō, vand chhakō, kirat karō.
title: Meditation on the Name
transliteration: Naam japo, vand chhako, kirat karo.

translated_text: Meditating on the Lord's Name, remembering the holy saints, pain becomes medicine, happiness becomes healing.
original_text: Har har simran simrat sād sant, dūkh darū sukh ṡālā.
title: Simran (Remembrance of God)
transliteration: Har har simran simrat sad sant, dukh daroo sukh shala.
